subject: german
title: Describing Family
meta_desc: KS3 German: mein/meine, possessives, family talk.
final_note: Use mein/meine to talk about your family.

walkthroughs.body_html: Mein + masculine/neuter noun: 'mein Bruder', 'mein Buch'. Meine + feminine/plural: 'meine Mutter', 'meine Eltern'. Match the gender.
'In meiner Familie sind wir vier Personen' = 'In my family we are four people'. Wir sind = we are.
Es gibt = there is/are. 'Es gibt drei Kinder' = there are three children. Useful for describing what's around.
